title: Airport Meet & Greet
eyebrow: A warm welcome. A seamless arrival.
summary: From arrival coordination to your onward transfer, feel looked after from the moment you land.
description: A considered arrival experience for returning Kenyans, international guests, corporate travellers, visiting artists, and first-time visitors. We coordinate the details around your flight so you can arrive with peace of mind.
includes: Real-time flight monitoring and delay tracking
In-terminal reception at international arrivals, subject to airport access arrangements
Baggage collection coordination and luggage assistance
Escort and handover to your pre-booked hotel transfer or onward transport
Kenyan cultural welcomes and performance coordination on request
24/7 on-call arrival coordination
note: Share your flight details, passenger numbers, and destination so we can confirm the appropriate arrival arrangements.

title: Car Hire & Chauffeur
eyebrow: Travel in comfort. Arrive with confidence.
summary: Dependable ground transport, from everyday journeys to executive chauffeur arrangements.
description: Punctual, professional transport for personal, family, and corporate travel. Whether you need an airport pickup, a day of meetings, or an intercity journey, we coordinate transport around your plans.
includes: Standard vehicles for everyday travel
Luxury SUVs for VIP logistics
Airport transfers and hotel pickups
Executive chauffeur coordination
Intercity journeys across Kenya
Flexible scheduling for personal, family, and corporate trips

title: VIP & Executive Concierge
summary: Thoughtful itinerary management, private transfers, and dedicated support for demanding schedules.
description: A discreet point of contact for executives and VIP guests who value privacy and attentive coordination. We bring your itinerary, accommodation, transport, and personal requests together, with dedicated support around your visit.
includes: Custom itinerary planning and executive meeting scheduling
Luxury hotel coordination and exclusive stay reservations
Dedicated chauffeur arrangements, airport meet and greet, and private transfers
Discreet handling of personal information and requests
Dining reservations and venue access coordination, subject to availability
Executive assistance, personal shopping, and bespoke experiences
24/7 dedicated concierge support by arrangement

title: Lifestyle Concierge
summary: Personal assistance and everyday coordination that give you back your most valuable asset: time.
description: From a thoughtful gift to a beautifully coordinated occasion, our lifestyle support is shaped around you. Ideal for busy professionals, diaspora families, expatriates, and anyone who needs a reliable local hand.
includes: Private event coordination, including venues, catering, decor, MCs, and entertainment
Dining reservations and appointment scheduling
Household courier and parcel coordination
Personal grocery and essential shopping
Gift sourcing, bespoke packaging, and doorstep delivery
Family support, school errands, and pharmacy collections
Floral arrangements and special-order deliveries

title: Relocation & Settling In
summary: Practical guidance and local coordination to help you feel at home in Kenya.
description: Moving is more than a journey. It is finding your neighbourhood, setting up your home, and getting everyday life working. We coordinate the practical steps, with local support before arrival and as you settle in.
includes: Documentation guidance and local administrative support
Home searches, neighbourhood sourcing, and school selection support
Airport pickups, transport coordination, and shopping errands
Utility connections and furnishing setup
Domestic staff sourcing and vetting
New and previously owned vehicle import assistance
Introductions to vetted local legal and financial professionals
note: Tell us when you are moving, who is relocating, and what a comfortable start in Kenya looks like for you.

eyebrow: Great journeys begin with great planning.

description: Get clarity before you take the next step. Our one-to-one consultations help you understand your options and put a practical plan in place, with introductions to appropriate local professionals where specialist advice is needed.
includes: Personalised planning for relocation and travel
Guidance on navigating local administrative processes
Coordination around property investment enquiries
Business liaison, local networking, and on-ground representation
One-to-one sessions on Kenyan systems, culture, and logistics
Introductions to lawyers, commissioners for oaths, and financial experts

eyebrow: A local presence for what matters to you.

Delivered materials checks and invoice auditing
Budget versus actual expenditure reviews

Live walkthrough calls and regular project updates
